headline: 2027 Mazda3 Sedan Arrives in Mexico, Bids Farewell to Manual Transmission and Light Hybrid System
summary: The 2027 Mazda3 sedan launches in Mexico without the manual transmission or mild-hybrid system, cutting the range to four versions with a slight price increase.
why: Mazda is a Japanese automaker with global sales, and Mexico is an important market for its vehicles. Pricing and trim changes affect its competitiveness in local markets.
original_headline: Mazda3 Sedán 2027 llega a México, se despide de la caja manual y el sistema híbrido ligero
